correctness.rationale: From e^2=f, ef=f, fe=0, f^2=f over F_2 obtain (a,b)(c,d)=(0,ac+ad+bd). All products are f-only. If (0,P) is a product-sum, right multiply by x_i to get Pb_i and left multiply to get P(a_i+b_i); adding gives Pa_i. Hence f-only product space W is an ideal in the full Boolean function algebra on A^n. Its diagonal generators q_ii=a_i+a_ib_i+b_i jointly vanish only at the zero tuple, so finite-function-algebra pointwise interpolation gives W={functions vanishing at 0} of dimension 4^n-1. The variable projections have linearly independent e-coordinate forms of dimension n, disjoint from W, proving dim_F2(F_n)=4^n+n-1, |F_n|=2^(4^n+n-1), and potential 4. Independent Boolean-ideal rank calculations gave 3,15,63 for n=1,2,3; the unrestricted claim follows from the ideal proof.
residual_risks: Only this four-element F_2 ring and ring language without unit constant; no extension to arbitrary algebras.
